prompts.title: Fashion Editorial Scrapbook Collage AI Prompt
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded photo only as the facial identity reference. Preserve the subject’s recognizable facial features, face shape, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, skin tone, hairstyle/hair texture, age, gender, and overall likeness. Ignore the original pose, clothing, background, framing, and lighting.

Create a premium fashion scrapbook / editorial collage portrait in a vertical 2:3 composition, featuring the same subject repeated throughout the design.

The main subject appears as a large full-body color cutout in the foreground, positioned slightly left of center and extending from near the upper-middle area to the bottom of the frame. The subject stands naturally facing the camera with a relaxed confident expression, one arm resting naturally beside the body and the other lightly holding the shoulder-bag strap. Keep realistic body proportions and a polished fashion-catalog pose.

Dress the subject in a stylish coral-red puff-sleeve peplum top, high-waisted light blue relaxed wide-leg jeans, and chunky cream/off-white open-toe sandals. Add a small cream crossbody/shoulder bag with a long strap, decorated with a cute embroidered red flower and subtle botanical details. Keep the wardrobe realistic, neat, youthful, and coordinated.

Give the foreground cutout a thick clean white sticker-style outline, followed by a very subtle soft shadow so it appears layered above the background collage.

BACKGROUND COLLAGE

Create four large horizontal rounded-rectangle photo panels, stacked vertically with equal spacing on a clean white background. Each panel should have softly rounded corners and contain a different black-and-white studio portrait of the exact same subject.

Keep all four background portraits monochrome with a smooth light-gray studio backdrop, subtle gradient lighting, soft shadows, and elegant fashion-editorial photography.

Use these poses:

Top panel: chest-up portrait wearing round dark sunglasses, one hand gently touching/adjusting the sunglasses, composed expression.
Second panel: upper-body portrait wearing the same sunglasses, head slightly tilted, lips slightly parted, relaxed fashion pose.
Third panel: upper-body portrait wearing sunglasses, one hand gently resting against the cheek, calm thoughtful expression.
Bottom panel: upper-body portrait wearing sunglasses, relaxed front-facing pose with a very subtle soft smile.

Keep the hairstyle consistent across all five appearances of the subject. The sunglasses should be classic small-to-medium round dark-lens fashion sunglasses, not oversized or futuristic.

COMPOSITION

The colorful full-body subject must overlap portions of the second, third, and fourth monochrome panels, creating strong foreground depth. Keep enough of every black-and-white portrait visible so the collage remains recognizable. Maintain clean white gaps between each rounded panel.

Use a bright pure-white outer background, minimal clutter, subtle realistic shadows, polished magazine-layout spacing.

IMAGE QUALITY

Ultra-clean premium fashion editorial, realistic skin texture, natural hands and fingers, accurate anatomy, sharp facial details, detailed fabric texture, realistic denim folds, realistic embroidered bag, clean cutout edges, soft professional studio lighting, high-resolution photography, sophisticated Pinterest-style aesthetic.

Important: every portrait and the foreground figure must clearly depict the same person with consistent identity. Do not create different faces, duplicate limbs, distorted hands, extra accessories, text, logos, or additional people. Do not change the subject’s age or gender.

Right hand raised across the chest adjusting the cufflink on the left wrist. Left hand lower, holding the cuff naturally. Hands must look realistic with subtle finger tension and natural asymmetry. Shot on 85mm lens, f/4, ISO 100, 1/125. Natural sharpness, no over-processing.
